This page records where each piece of the wiki comes from and who has checked what. The labels are explained on [[How to contribute#Labels|How to contribute]]. {{Demo}}

== Rules ==
* Text drafted by Claude (AI) carries {{Demo}} until a member of the page team replaces or approves it.
* Arguments produced by AI systems appear only as verbatim quotations, with source and date, or as entries labelled {{Raw}} on [[Raw data]].
* The first line of each page records its team, its status and the checks made. A machine check is recorded as such and never counts as a human check.
* Statements attributed to a paper give its theorem number; synthesis proofs say which papers they follow.
* Every accepted proposal is linked, in the edit summary, to the Zulip topic where it was discussed.

== This version ==
On 8 November 2026 the wiki was reorganized into the parts drawn on the [[Overview#Map of the wiki|map]], and its pages were reduced to a skeleton, to be filled by the editorial board and contributors. The first version (6 November 2026: Couette flow with three proofs, a hypocoercivity page, the toolkit, the history) is kept in the project folder, in <code>archive/2026-11-06-first-version</code>. The only computed content is the video on the Overview, with its record on [[Numerical methods]], made by Claude (AI) and not yet checked by a human. The TeX source of each page is generated from the wiki by a script.
